extracted.name: Mushroom pie
extracted.description: This pie crust is super simple to make! One of my favorite dishes to serve at get-together / dinner parties with friends. Looking forward to a #postpandemic life...:-)
instruction_lines: Mix all crust ingredients together, and form a round shape. Fry the mushroom topping ingredients briefly on a pan.
Bake in 350F / 180 C for about 30-40 minutes
